steps.title: Coloured clay → the take
steps.text: Block the shot on the stage: the set, the cast, the camera and the stunt. The Color pass (coloured clay) guides the video model, and the take keeps the blocking frame for frame. Press Play on the stage, then replay ④ Frame and ⑤ Motion.
steps.say: The J-turn in Color, from the bumper cam: press Play, or run ④ Frame and ⑤ Motion to replay the real renders.

clips.label: Clay | Final
clips.note: Left: this stage's Color pass (Stunt B, bumper cam in the next lane, 26 mm). Right: the LTX-2.5 Final it guided (1984 × 1088, seed 5101, first frame FLUX 3 Klein seed 5101, Racing Cinema look). Same 121 frames.

steps.title: Load a script → scenes, cast, stage
steps.text: Load a screenplay (a sample, your own Fountain, Final Draft or PDF, or paste one) and ① Script breaks it down in your browser: scenes, cast, locations, props and vehicles, with the pages. Pick a scene and the 3D stage sets itself up from its heading: the set, the light, the cast blocked. ④ Frame and ⑤ Motion then replay the closest recorded example, labelled as such.
steps.say: Low Tide is broken down and scene 1 is on the stage. Pick another scene, or Load a script (top bar) for your own. ③ Set shows the stage.

steps.title: ✦ Ask: Show me, then Do it for me
steps.text: Ask how to do anything. Here the question is "how do I make it rain?". First press Show me, step by step: it lights up the real controls so you can do it yourself. Then press Do it for me: the App plans "make it rain", you press Apply, and rain falls on the stage. Undo this puts it back.
steps.say: 1. Show me, step by step (lights up the controls). 2. Do it for me, then Apply: rain on the stage. Undo this puts it back.

steps.title: Drive mode
steps.text: Select anything and press D: drive the car with WASD, the mouse or a game controller, walk a person up to it and press E to get in, ride a horse, throw a crate. ● REC turns what you did into ordinary keys on the shot.
steps.say: The red car is selected: press D to drive it (W/S throttle and brake, A/D steer, Space handbrake, Esc to stop). R records.

clips.label: One take: walk, drive, ride, throw
clips.note: Recorded in the App with an emulated controller: a person gets into the car and drives, gets out, mounts the horse and gallops. Plain clay, no render.

steps.title: Boats on real waves
steps.text: Speedboats, a fishing boat, a sailing dinghy and a yacht, a canoe, a kayak, a rowboat and rafts. Hulls float on a wave field, plane at speed, heel under sail and leave a wake; paddles pull in time. Presets: Speedboat run, Sailing tack, Canoe on a calm lake, Whitewater raft.
steps.say: Press Play: the speedboat climbs onto the plane and leaves its wake. ④ Frame and ⑤ Motion replay the real renders.

clips.label: Speedboat: clay | Draft
clips.note: LTX-2.5 Draft from this stage. Flaw: the crew grows from two to three or four.

clips.label: Canoe: clay | Draft
clips.note: LTX-2.5 Draft. Flaw: a third paddler appears by the dock.

steps.title: Boats: clay → Final
steps.text: The Speedboat run preset with one driver and a 30 mm lens, so the whole hull stays in frame. The coloured clay guided the take: the hull climbs onto the plane at 2.3 s exactly as blocked. ④ Frame and ⑤ Motion replay the real renders from this stage.
steps.say: Press Play: the one-driver speedboat. ④ Frame and ⑤ Motion replay this stage's own Klein frame, Draft and Final.

clips.label: Color | Final
clips.note: Left: this stage's Color pass. Right: the LTX-2.5 Final it guided (1984 × 1088, seed 2201, with sound). Flaws: the pines are evenly spaced cones from the clay and read slightly CG; a tiny figure on the far dock from about 2.5 s; the wake is cut by the right edge.

steps.title: Boats: the blocking, then the shot
steps.text: First the 3D blocking: the speedboat run on the stage in coloured clay, one driver, no dock. Then the render of the same shot from the same camera: the clay guided it frame for frame.
steps.say: Press Play: the speedboat run in Color. The clip shows the newest staging (no dock) with its own clay and Final.

clips.label: Clay | Final (no dock)
clips.note: Left: this staging's Color pass (no dock, one driver). Right: the LTX-2.5 HQ Final it guided (seed 2201, Loose adherence, with sound), first frame FLUX 3 Klein. A separate staging, not a render of the stage behind it.

steps.title: Underwater: going under
steps.text: The camera sinks from 1 m to 2.5 m under the surface and settles, aimed near level so the god rays stay in shot and the seabed clutter stays small. Depth of field, water attenuation (reds die first) and grain are added in post, never in the video prompt.
steps.say: The reef stage in Color. ④ Frame and ⑤ Motion replay this stage's own Klein frame and Hollywood take.

clips.label: Color | Hollywood + lens pass
clips.note: Left: this stage's Color pass. Right: the LTX-2.5 Hollywood take (2624 × 1408, seed 3304) with a post depth-of-field, attenuation and grain pass. Flaws: no fish; the rays and ripples are too regular.

steps.title: Night street: a car pass
steps.text: A locked-off camera on the sidewalk in the rain; a police car drives through frame from 1.7 s to 3.4 s, so the plate is empty before and after. The ④ still names only what the camera sees at frame 1.
steps.say: Night street in Color: press Play. ④ Frame and ⑤ Motion replay this stage's own Klein frame, Draft and Final.

clips.label: Color | Final
clips.note: Left: this stage's Color pass. Right: the LTX-2.5 Final it guided (1984 × 1088, seed 1101, with sound). Flaws: the rear quarter smears as the car exits right; the light bar reads steady rather than strobing; the rain is thin.

steps.title: Swimming
steps.text: Divers flutter-kick at a cadence worked out from their speed, with the regulator in the mouth and bubbles leaving in bursts on each exhale. At the surface: freestyle with the body roll, breaststroke and treading water. Caustics move on the sand.
steps.say: Clay view, playing: watch the kick, the fins and the bubble bursts.

steps.title: Video → 3D set
steps.text: Drop a clip on the stage: the App solves the camera, finds the people and things, and rebuilds the shot as a 3D set you can re-shoot. The Identical? bar lays the source over the rebuild (Wipe, Overlay, Onion) and scores the match. Here the clip is loaded for you: press Rebuild to replay a real run.
steps.say: The J-turn clip is in the Video → 3D chooser: press Rebuild as a 3D set to replay the real run.

clips.label: Another clip: source | reshoot
clips.note: A different run, not the J-turn: a 5 s street-dance clip (Pexels) rebuilt as a 3D set, then re-shot from a new ±52° orbit with LTX-2.5 (HQ Hollywood, seed 4402) and a post lens pass. Left: the source. Right: the reshoot. Flaws: the model invents a second leaning slab and a pillar as the orbit swings round; the head-wrap knot changes shape at 1.9-2.6 s; the face is a look-alike, not the performer.

steps.title: ✦ One-click
steps.text: Every take and every ④ Frame candidate has ✦ One-click: weather and time of day, 18 relights, new camera angles and expands, each with its cost asked first. The result lands as a new take.
steps.say: ④ Frame replayed its candidates: ✦ on a candidate opens One-click. Running a card needs the GPU (full install).

clips.label: Neon relight
clips.note: Top: the original frame. Bottom: the FLUX 3 Klein Neon relight, every object kept.

steps.title: The shot strip and the brass key
steps.text: The scene button now has its own line under the shot tiles, so a click on a tile never sets the scene up again (checked at 1024, 1280, 1600 and 1920 wide). Small props can be held, tossed and snatched: on the Last Light stage the brass key passes from rider to rider on its cue.

clips.label: Strip: before
clips.note: Before: the yellow Set up scene button covered tiles 1M to 1P.

clips.label: The key, shot by shot
clips.note: Camera view of each setup. Flaw: in clay the key reads small and grey; its brass shows only in Color.

steps.title: One canvas, down to 1024 wide
steps.text: The seven steps run across the top, tools on the left rail, the selection's properties on the right. In a 1024-wide window the top row folds its least-used buttons into ⋯ and no panel covers the strip. Press H over the stage to hide every panel.
steps.say: Seven steps across the top; narrow the window and the top row folds into ⋯. H hides the panels.

steps.title: Pitch Mode and the Director
steps.text: In the Director panel, press Pitch (or P) and talk the scene through: "Night. Rainy alley. A detective walks toward camera. A car's headlights sweep across him." Each sentence builds the set, cast and blocking, and FLUX 3 Klein sketches the beat. Lock it turns the beats into shots, each sketch as its first frame. Listening and the sketches run on the GPU in the full install.
steps.say: Pitch (P) in the Director panel: talk the scene through, the set builds itself beat by beat.

clips.label: Pitch Mode, live
clips.note: Recorded in the App: six spoken beats (macOS text-to-speech), the set building and a sketch per beat.

steps.title: Stunts and live physics
steps.text: Stunts are driven by a vehicle-dynamics simulation, not hand keys: a floored launch with a fishtail, a closed-loop donut, a handbrake 180. The stunt-sprung body rolls and pitches on its springs; the tyres smoke on dry ground and throw spray on wet.
steps.say: The red car is selected: pick a stunt, then Play. The keys stay editable.
